name: Ukulele boy
source:
Mihi has been working in a marriage agency for paranormal creatures for five years, but has never fulfilled his long-standing dream of meeting a mermaid.
By claiming to having met one on the southern coast of the island, his colleague Nero dissuades him from resignation.
Is this true or just Nero's make-believe to not be left alone at work in the company of fellow oddballs?
